limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--saved-history-compact-dark.task: Scan saved conversations and their facts beside the complete saved reply.
conversation--saved-history-compact-dark.observations: Title, project, metadata and selection are legible in both appearances. Compact history exposes the draft but its actions fall below the scroll boundary; the selected reply is pushed entirely below the fold. Excess spacing around the draft disclosure and saved-reply heading blocks the intended compact reading task.
